BSD 3-Clause; see Valve-Gloves-LICENSE.txt.
Modified for NOVR: axis conversion, skin data serialization, pose retargeting, preserved UV seams, runtime pilot-palette tint and normal-map channel conversion. No Nuclear Option assets are included.
Assets/SteamVR/Models/Materials/vr_glove_color.jpg and vr_glove_normal.png are also used under the same license.
